## Done — commit `3b1e344d`

**AI and Sessions are now one tab, "AI"** (`ext/drawer/tabs.js`, `tabs/ai.js`). A header strip above the chat makes the owner's own questions answerable at a glance:
- the session's name + a link to its raw log
- the fast/smart assistants as **working / idle / asleep** chips (reused `GET /api/agents` — no new route)
- a short switcher to other recent sessions, plus the shared **"+ New session"** button
- `?drawer=sessions` still opens the right place (the AI tab)

**"+ New session"** also sits beside **"+ New card"** on `/framework/ai/`'s own Inbox dashboard (`ai2/rail.js`) — same shared button, not a second one.

**The composer is one panel now** (`ext/Chat/Composer.js`, `ext/Chat/Chat.css`): its own tinted background + a top border separate it from the chat feed above, and the row reads **mic → gear → Send**, Send pinned to the far edge, flush with the textarea's own edges.

**Admin folded into Settings** (`tabs/settings.js` calls `admin.js`'s own function, unchanged) so the tab row fits one line at the drawer's 19rem width instead of wrapping onto two.

**Proof** (headless, stubbed Servex, never your tabs) — shots + `report.json` in `public/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/minion-drawer-chat/shots/` (gitignored, left on disk):
- `drawer-ai-1920.png` / `drawer-ai-400.png` / `drawer-ai-1920-dark.png` — header, chips, switcher, composer
- `drawer-settings-1920.png` — Admin folded in, zero console errors
- `dictate-overview-1200.png` — the Dictate page's own demo wearing the identical composer
- `inbox-new-session-1920.png` — "+ New session" beside "+ New card"
- the new-session click test confirmed the header repaints instantly and a real (stubbed) `POST /api/session/new` fires on the next message

**Left for the mastermind to weigh**: the mobile ✦ sheet didn't get its own header/chips (only the drawer's `?drawer=ai` + 400px sheet-equivalent were in scope); the old Sessions tab's dev-bar Ask threads/sub-cards weren't folded into the new strip — those stay reachable in the dev bar unchanged. Both are noted in `task.jsonl`, with the reasoning.

## Done — commit `2ef2f5a3`

All 3 findings fixed and answered in `task.jsonl` (`{"review":{"answer":{"n":1..3,...}}}`):

1. **Composer is one real panel now**, not a box inside the feed card. `Widget.js` makes it a sibling of the feed card under a new `.ux-dictate-widget-shell`; the card's bottom border/radius are squared off, the composer runs full width with its own background and continues the card's border around the bottom — one shape. Also caught and fixed a 5px gap (stale v1 padding bleeding into the new composer) while measuring it. Re-checked all 4 surfaces this touches — drawer, the standalone Dictate page, the ai2 card sidebar (which strips borders on purpose — updated `Card.css` to match), and the mobile sheet — all clean.
2. **`doc/tabs.md` rewritten** (the real gap — missed in round 1), plus `doc/file/tabs.js.md` and `menu.js`'s own ☰ tooltip. The drawer page and readme were already right.
3. **Switcher shot with 3 sessions** at 1920/400 (fixed a real layout bug found while shooting it — the list sat wedged inside the button row). **Tab row at 19rem: 304px wide, 28px tall, one line, 4 tabs.**

Shots in `public/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/minion-drawer-chat/shots/`: `box-fix-1920.png`, `box-fix-400.png`, `box-fix-1920-dark.png`, `switcher-1920.png`, `switcher-400.png`, `card-sidebar-1920.png`, `mobile-sheet-400.png`, `dictate-overview-1200-round2.png`, `round2-report.json`.

**Left for later** (not in this review's scope): the drawer walkthrough still has pre-merge screenshots — needs a re-shoot, logged in `task.jsonl`.

**Done.** The fast assistant now refines every owner utterance live, with its cost, in voice/chat.

**What changed**
- `Servex/agents/Sessions.js` — `say()` now runs the owner's line through the shared Refine engine (`clean()` + `structure()`, the same one Echo.js uses for VS Code prompts — no second engine) in the background, via `servex.echo.call()` so it reuses Echo's own model-call loop guard for free. Writes one `{refined: {at, re, sentences, sections, flags, cost_usd}}` line.
- `ext/Session/Session.js` `entry()` and `ux/Dictate/Widget.js`'s `Thread` draw that as a small collapsed "refined" block right under the owner's bubble.
- `ux/Dictate/chat.js` — found and fixed a real wiring gap: its own `draw()` is the one function every real stream line actually passes through (for both the ✦ sheet and the desktop drawer), and it didn't know about `refined` lines at all. Without this fix the new line would have been silently dropped.
- Docs: `ext/Session/doc/markers.md` and `doc/sessions.md` now describe the new line, and call out that it's a different thing from the pre-existing `level`-based "refined" reply.

**Proof**
- Node test (stubbed `call`, no real model): all 6 checks pass — one `refined` line lands with the right `re` and a summed `cost_usd`.
- Headless shot of the real ✦ sheet at 400px: `public/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/minion-voice-refine/shots/refined-400.png` (collapsed) and `refined-400-open.png` (opened, showing sections/sentence-ids/cost).

**Commit:** `d0c6b66919c6592cd5371a4ad3513a99e7724675` on `worktree/voice-refine` — not merged.

Needs a Servex restart (your parent asks mastermind-servex-9) before it's live.

**Review round answered — all 7 findings.**

- **Finding 1 (fix):** deleted the duplicate `parse_sections`/`parse_cites`/`sections_with_ids` from `Sessions.js`; `refine()` now calls `echo.sections_with_ids(echo.parse_sections(built.md))` off the live Echo instance. Echo.js untouched.
- **Finding 5:** added `worth_refining(line)` — skips any line under 2 sentences *and* under 15 words, and skips `floor: "speaking"` outright regardless of length.
- **Finding 2:** test moved out of the scratchpad and committed at `minion-voice-refine/refine.test.mjs`, with new cases for the short-line skip, the speaking-floor skip, and a long-one-sentence line that still qualifies.
- **Finding 6:** proof only, no fix needed — loaded `/framework/ext/Session/` headless, replayed a real `{refined}` line through `Session.entry()` + the real `ext/Chat` `chat()` factory: 0 bubbles drawn. (Root cause: `type: "refined"` already means something else in `ext/Chat/Chat.js` — a different, `of`-keyed mechanism — so it harmlessly no-ops on mine.)
- **Findings 3, 4, 7:** noted, no action (shots gitignored by design; cost decimals fine as-is; rest approved).

`refine.test.mjs`: 13/13 checks pass.
